Cognitive accessibility determines whether people can actually finish a task. Interfaces fail quietly when instructions are long.

Short words help. Long sentences with subordinate clauses, parenthetical qualifications and unexplained abbreviations make comprehension considerably harder for everyone reading quickly.

Navigation should be predictable. Labels should match destinations. Checkout should never surprise anyone with unexpected fees.

Internationalization, authentication, interoperability and multidimensional configuration are examples of technical vocabulary.

Read the guide. Then try it. Ask for help if anything is unclear!

Performance budgets matter because slow pages cost attention, and attention is the scarcest resource a visitor brings.
